title: 85% faster takedowns: an AI just pulled a game off Google Play
description:
85% faster takedowns: an AI just pulled a game off Google Play

An automated copyright claim filed on behalf of Microsoft got Luanti, the open source voxel game engine, removed from the Play Store this week. The notice cited the Minecraft Java Edition 1.9 registration, US Reg. #TX 8-192-097, and never specified a single asset.

Luanti ships with no games and no proprietary assets. What it bundles is a handful of engine textures and properly licensed fonts.

The company that filed it sells AI brand protection and markets 85% faster takedowns, six times faster review, and 44% more takedowns month over month. There is no accuracy number anywhere in that pitch.

The same firm filed the same claim against the same project in 2023. That one took 46 days to reverse.

Source: Luanti blog, 27 August 2026.
